Savor the mouthwatering experience of our Classic Cheeseburger, an American favorite that never goes out of style. Sink your teeth into a succulent beef patty, grilled to perfection and topped with a slice of gooey, melted American cheese. This masterpiece is then adorned with crisp, fresh lettuce, a slice of ripe tomato, tangy pickles, and just the right amount of thinly sliced onions, all nestled between two pillowy soft, sesame seed buns.
